train_one_epoch: train a Deformable DETR model for one epoch using a data loader, criterion, and optimizer
run_train_one_epoch_with_grad_clipping: run train_one_epoch with gradient clipping by setting max_norm to clip gradient norms
evaluate_model: evaluate a Deformable DETR model on a test dataset and return COCO and panoptic stats
run_evaluate_with_coco_evaluator: run evaluate to compute bbox and segmentation IoU metrics using a CocoEvaluator
run_evaluate_with_panoptic_evaluator: run evaluate to compute panoptic quality metrics using a PanopticEvaluator
